_doc: Hard ceilings the risk-invariants job holds every AUTO-tier PR to. Read statically (ast, never imported) from the PR head. A value above its ceiling, a constant that is no longer a plain literal, a constant or file that disappeared, or a rail list that lost a member FAILS the job, and the release controller quarantines the PR. The CLEAR + APPROVE MERGES path ignores this job: a change zuck approves himself may move a ceiling. This file is PROTECTED.
